trigger.summary: Routine fleet health check of the inference service. Review the attached monitoring snapshot, investigate anything abnormal with the available tools, and repair it if a declared action is supported by evidence.

evidence.finding: Per-worker latency and errors through the HAProxy entry point.
Configuration keys whose values differ between the workers.
Per-worker latency and errors directly and through HAProxy.

target-a.finding: All metrics are within normal limits; configuration matches reviewed baseline; path latency and errors are consistent direct‑and‑through‑haproxy; tool‑call canary valid.

target-b.finding: All metrics are within normal limits; configuration matches reviewed baseline; path latency and errors are consistent direct‑and‑through‑haproxy; tool‑call canary valid.

payload.observations: Both target-a and target-b are operating within normal limits. All measured metrics (error rate, p95 latency, request counts) are below the configured thresholds, configuration diffs show no deviations from the reviewed baseline, path‑compare shows identical latency and errors whether traffic goes directly or through HAProxy, and tool‑call canary probes on each worker report valid structured calls. No abnormal symptoms are present on either resource directly or via the entry point.
